What you’ll be doing: Providing Level 1 and general IT support to users Troubleshooting hardware, software and Microsoft 365 issues Supporting users across Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and other M365 applications Assisting with user accounts, access and basic administration Logging, managing and resolving service desk requests Escalating more complex technical issues when required Providing clear and friendly support to users with varying levels of technical knowledge Maintaining accurate documentation and ticket updates What we’re looking for: Previous experience in a Service Desk, Help Desk or IT Support role Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Excellent customer service and communication skills Good troubleshooting and problem-solving ability Ability to explain technical issues in simple, easy-to-understand language A proactive and approachable attitude Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team 📍 Location: Victor Harbor, SA If you have a strong customer service mindset, solid Microsoft 365 experience and enjoy helping people with technology, we’d love to hear from you.
